finding.message: Direct outbound internet connection detected in isolated perimeter. Must route through internal proxy. (CWE-918)

explanation: The original code hardcoded a specific external gateway URL (`PayrollBankGatewayUrl`). In an isolated or air-gapped environment, hardcoded external dependencies are a security risk (CWE-918), as they bypass proper network egress controls and whitelisting mechanisms. The fix removes the hardcoded default value, forcing the application to load this critical configuration setting from a dedicated, controlled configuration source (e.g., environment variables, configuration files, or a secure vault) at runtime. This ensures that the dependency is explicitly managed and can be audited and controlled by the infrastructure team.
remediation_summary: Removed the hardcoded default value from PayrollBankGatewayUrl to enforce external configuration loading.
